'''[[Egypt]]''' competed at the '''[[2014 Summer Youth Olympics]]''', in [[Nanjing]], [[China]] from 16 August to 28 August 2014.

==Medalists==
Medals awarded to participants of [[Mixed-NOCs participation at the 2014 Summer Youth Olympics|mixed-NOC (combined)]] teams are represented in ''italics''. These medals are not counted towards the individual NOC medal tally.

==Archery==
{{main|Archery at the 2014 Summer Youth Olympics}}

Egypt qualified a male and female archer from its performance at the African Continental Qualification Tournament.<ref>{{cite news | url= http://www.worldarchery.org/Portals/1/Documents/Olympics/YOG/2014_Nanjing/YOG-Boys.pdf| title=Youth Olympics Games-2014 Qualification Places Boys | work=[[World Archery Federation]] | date=23 April 2014 | access-date=1 May 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite news | url= http://www.worldarchery.org/Portals/1/Documents/Olympics/YOG/2014_Nanjing/YOG-Girls.pdf| title=Youth Olympics Games-2014 Qualification Places Girls | work=[[World Archery Federation]] | date=23 April 2014 | access-date=1 May 2014}}</ref>

{{main|Badminton at the 2014 Summer Youth Olympics}}

==Basketball==
{{main|Basketball at the 2014 Summer Youth Olympics}}

Egypt qualified a girls' team based on the 1 June 2014 [[FIBA]] 3x3 National Federation Rankings.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://bbm.fiba.com/images.fiba.com/Document/65d36d9a/3d8b/406a/8fda/a64a14dae7b8.pptx | title=3x3 basketball | work=[[FIBA]] | date=24 June 2014 | access-date=10 July 2014 }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{cite news | url= https://www.fiba.basketball/news/3x3-Pools-unveiled-for-3x3-event-at-2014-Youth-Olympic-Games| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20181024113353/http://www.fiba.basketball/news/3x3-Pools-unveiled-for-3x3-event-at-2014-Youth-Olympic-Games| url-status= live| archive-date= October 24, 2018| title=3x3 - Pools unveiled for 3x3 event at 2014 Youth Olympic Games | work=[[FIBA]] | date=24 June 2014 | access-date=10 July 2014}}</ref>

==Wrestling==
{{main|Wrestling at the 2014 Summer Youth Olympics}}

Egypt qualified five athletes based on its performance at the 2014 African Cadet Championships.<ref>{{cite news | url=http://www.fila-official.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=1287%3Awrestling-qualifiers-named-for-youth-olympic-games&catid=60%3Aactualite&Itemid=100235&lang=en | title=Wrestling Qualifiers Named for Youth Olympic Games | work=[[International Federation of Associated Wrestling Styles|FILA]] | date=28 July 2014 | access-date=30 July 2014 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140810041126/http://www.fila-official.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=1287:wrestling-qualifiers-named-for-youth-olympic-games&catid=60:actualite&Itemid=100235&lang=en | archive-date=2014-08-10 | url-status=dead }}</ref>
